summary_en: This note derives an Abel/partial summation identity for series of the form \(\sum a_n b_n\) and uses it to extend Dirichlet's test under weaker hypotheses. It also presents several examples showing how growth estimates for partial sums imply convergence or divergence.

problems.statement_en: Extension 1 of Dirichlet's test: keep the condition that \(|B_N|<\infty\) for every positive integer \(N\), but replace the assumption that \(a_n\) decreases monotonically to \(0\) by the weaker assumption that \(a_n\) has bounded variation and converges to \(0\). Then the series \(\sum a_n b_n\) converges.
problems.statement_zh: 原本的判别当中，依旧保持\(\left|B_N\right|<\infty\)对任意的正整数\(N\)成立,但是把\(a_n\)单调收敛到0替换为，\(a_n\)有界变差收敛到0。

problems.statement_en: If \(|a_n-a_{n+1}| = O(1/n^{M+1})\), then to make \(\sum_{n=1}^{N-1} B_n(a_n-a_{n+1})\) absolutely convergent it suffices to assume \(B_n = O(n^{M-\varepsilon_0})\). Hence the original series \(\sum a_n b_n\) converges.
problems.statement_zh: 如果\(|a_n - a_{n+1}| = O\left(\frac{1}{n^{M+1}}\right)\)这个时候其实不需要给到\(\left|B_N\right|<\infty\)如此强的条件的，想要\(\sum_{n=1}^{N-1}B_n(a_n-a_{n+1})\)绝对收敛实际上只需要\(B_n =O(n^{M-\varepsilon_0})\)因此原来的级数一定是收敛的。

problems.statement_en: If \(a_n\) is monotone, \(|a_n-a_{n+1}| \gg 1/n^{M+1}\), \(B_n \gg n^M\), and the limit of \(B_n a_n\) exists, then since \(B_n|a_n-a_{n+1}| \gg 1/n\), the original series \(\sum a_n b_n\) diverges.
problems.statement_zh: 如果我们知道\(a_n\)是单调的，并且\(|a_n - a_{n+1}| \gg \frac{1}{n^{M+1}},B_n\gg n^{M}\)同时假设\(B_na_n\)的极限是存在的，那么由于\(B_n|a_{n}-a_{n+1}|\gg \frac{1}{n}\)因此原来的级数一定是发散的。

problems.statement_en: Assume \(\sum_{j=1}^{n} a_j = o(\sqrt{n})\). Prove that \(\sum_j \frac{a_j}{j}\) converges.
problems.statement_zh: 假设\(\sum_{j = 1}^{n} a_j = o\left(\sqrt{n}\right)\),证明：\(\sum_{j} \frac{a_j}{j}\) 收敛。

problems.statement_en: Show that the series \(\sum_{n\ge 1}\frac{|\sin n|}{n}\) diverges.
